Irtysh won the Kazakhstan Premier league in 1993 (as ''Ansat''), 1997, 1999, 2002 and 2003. The club was also founding members of the top league and never relegated to lower levels before being dissolved in 2020. It entered [[Kazakhstan Second League]] in 2024 and was promoted to [[Kazakhstan First League]] for 2025. Irtysh had participated in the [[AFC Champions League]] a number of times, reaching the semi-finals in 2001 (the final year of Kazakhstan's [[Asian Football Confederation|AFC]] affiliation), and played in [[UEFA Champions League 2003-04|UEFA Champions League]] qualifying round in [[UEFA Champions League 2003-04|2003]]."}}
